## Heroicons

Copyright (c) Tailwind Labs, Inc. MIT. Heroicons 2.2.0 supplies the following paths adapted in `src/product-patterns/product-nav-icon.tsx`. Full license: [Heroicons MIT](licenses/npm/_heroicons_react_2.2.0/LICENSE).

| Local symbol | Upstream icon | Modifications |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HomeDetails | HomeIcon | 房屋外框与上游相同路径片段；门拆分并添加动画 |
| ArtifactDetails | RectangleStackIcon | 三层卡片几何经重写；按产品导航原始映射归属；不是逐字相同路径 |
| TaskDetails | ClipboardDocumentListIcon | 主体路径沿用；列表拆分并添加动画 |
| ConnectorDetails | Squares2X2Icon | 四个方块参数化重写，新增位移及旋转 |
| McpDetails | ServerStackIcon | 主体沿用；指示点及数据线拆分动画 |
| SkillDetails | BoltIcon | 相同折线顶点，改为绝对坐标，新增变形 |
| KnowledgeDetails | BookOpenIcon | 主体 d 文本完全相同；新增翻页图形 |
| EditAgentDetails | PencilSquareIcon | 上游完整路径按铅笔和边框拆分并调换顺序；新增动画 |
| WorkspaceArtifactDetails | ArchiveBoxIcon | 上游盒身、盒盖与细节线拆分为独立路径；新增动画 |
| ScheduleDetails | CalendarDaysIcon | 原产品映射为 CalendarDaysIcon；主体弧线标志和日期点写法有调整，拆分动画 |
| ChannelDetails | ChatBubbleLeftRightIcon | 两个气泡路径拆分；新增动画 |

The separate `PrimaryNavAgentIcon` CSS robot is not attributed to Heroicons; this mapping concerns the 11 SVG-based ProductNavIcon symbols only.
